testcase.name: a tap on the chip shows the legend with each ramp's 0 and 100 percent, the dates, no forecast here and the reference class, and a second tap hides it
with the cluster dragged to the bottom on the right it stops above the chip, rises when the legend expands and returns when it collapses
touches on the map all around the legend chip reach the map
with the release build's store the sheet lists no colour field, no legend shows, and no credit is added
with no colour field visible there is no legend chip, and switching one on in the sheet shows it
with forecast data the colour fields are listed top first with an opacity slider and a reorder handle, and Move up reorders them
while a colour field is visible the legend chip shows at the bottom right above the nav, collapsed to 2 layers
choosing a map type in the sheet applies it and the sheet stays open
a touch on the opacity slider sets that layer's opacity, and its value reads as a percent
dragging a colour field's handle down one row moves it one place down
once the sheet is closed, touches where it was and around the Layers row reach the map
a real touch on the Layers row opens the Layers sheet, with Map type and the Maps tab's eight overlays
expanded, the legend is capped in height and a real swipe on it scrolls the reference class into view
switching Finds off in the sheet hides finds in the state the map is handed, and stores the choice
